## Who is Omar Fourati?

Omar Fourati is a Full-Stack Developer and AI Specialist based in Cologne (Köln), Germany.
He has 4+ years of professional software development experience, working both as a working student
and as a full-time Software Developer at Keravonos GmbH since October 2025.

He holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from TH Köln (Campus Gummersbach), graduating in September 2025.

## Selected Projects

### KI-WM-Prognosen (AI World Cup Predictions)
AI predictions for FIFA World Cup 2026 using 4 LLM models (GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, Grok).
Transparent forecasts with reasoning in 5 languages.
Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, OpenAI, Claude

### Trading Bot (Algorithmic Trading System)
Production-grade algorithmic trading system with ML predictions, technical analysis,
backtesting, and live market monitoring via MetaTrader5.
Stack: Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, MetaTrader5, Dash, PostgreSQL

### KerChat (Real-time Chat Platform)
Real-time Slack-clone with OAuth authentication, WebSockets, multi-channel support.
Stack: Vue 3, FastAPI, WebSockets, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Google OAuth, MariaDB

### Pronto (B2B Sales Intelligence Platform)
B2B sales intelligence platform aggregating intent signals and generating AI-personalized outreach.
Stack: Vue 3, FastAPI, OpenAI, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Playwright, MariaDB

### Private-Key-Manager (Enterprise PWA)
Enterprise PWA for secure credential management with client-side AES-256-GCM encryption
and zero-knowledge architecture.
Stack: React, Node.js, AES-256-GCM, Docker, Nginx, PostgreSQL, JWT
